sections.title: Run loop
sections.questions: What is one run; how does it start, end (win, death, timeout) and restart? What is shared between players?

sections.title: Architecture
sections.questions: Which Verse files/classes own run state, transitions, player state, spawning, rewards? One owner per transition.

sections.title: Devices in the level
sections.questions: Which spawners, trackers, modifiers and UI devices exist; which are global and which per player; who wires them? (read them via the MCP when live)

sections.title: Progression
sections.questions: What persists between runs and what resets; unlocks, currencies, difficulty scaling. Numbers only from the owner or his maps' data.

sections.title: Strategies around death and progress
sections.questions: Retry rules, paid retry or continue, rewards, boosts. Design strategies, learned as patterns with a variant.

sections.title: Persistence
sections.questions: What is stored per player; what happens when data is not loaded yet or the player left.

sections.title: Launch checklist
sections.questions: First 10 minutes of a new player, a full run, a death, a restart, two players at once, a player leaving mid-run.
